files.purpose: Declares @MainActor final class CommandCodeSession: ProviderSession, the driver for the Command Code CLI (`cmd`) in headless print mode: every turn spawns one `cmd -p --output-format json` process with the prompt piped on stdin, parses its newline-delimited event frames and final result line into ProviderEvents, and resumes the conversation on later turns with `--resume <sessionId>` after checking the transcript still exists under ~/.commandcode/projects. It also owns Droppy Code's own approval gate for that CLI: the run is given `--yolo` plus the CommandCodeAPI approval mod (`--mod`), the mod writes <id>.request.json files into a per-session approvals directory watched with a DispatchSource, and the session auto-approves by runtime mode or session grant, otherwise raises an ApprovalRequest with Approve / Approve for session / Decline and answers with an atomically written <id>.reply.json. At B3 the file keeps all of that behaviour but delegates message/thinking id and text bookkeeping to StreamedTextTracker, write_file before/after snapshots to EditSnapshots (both in the new SessionSupport.swift), the session-grant key to ApprovalRequest.Kind.grantKey (ProviderSession.swift) and todo_write parsing to ACPSession.parseTodoItems.

feature_notes: B2->B3 (commit d70cff8fe 'refactor: audit cleanups — five bug fixes, shared MCP and provider code, layer rules restored'), churn 113: seven private stream fields (messageCounter, thinkingCounter, currentMessageID, currentThinkingID, messageText, thinkingText, streamedText) are replaced by one StreamedTextTracker; launchID moves from a property initializer to init (:76-77) so the tracker's id closures can capture it. Id shapes stay "cc-<launchID>-m<n>" and "cc-<launchID>-r<n>", counters stay per session, and every message_start / text_delta / thinking_start / thinking_delta / thinking_end / message_end transition is equivalent: startMessage resets text and streamedText, appendMessage mints an id lazily without resetting text, appendThinking(resetsText: false) mints lazily keeping thinkingText (the Command Code fallback), message_end calls endMessage and endThinking, send calls resetForTurn (streamedText = false only) and didClose calls resetIDs. No observable change.

editSnapshots changes from [String: String] to EditSnapshots; the private static snapshot(_:) (1 MB UTF-8 read) moves into EditSnapshots.read (SessionSupport.swift:36-40) and the before/after diff body of finishEdit moves into EditSnapshots.finish (:27-33). finishEdit (:602-605) now checks toolInputs[id]["file_path"] BEFORE removing the snapshot (B2 removed first); because a snapshot is only captured for a write_file whose input has a string file_path and toolInputs[id] holds that same input, the reorder has no observable effect. makeToolCall and makeApproval now receive editSnapshots.text(id), which is "" instead of nil for an uncaptured id; the only consumer (write_file's `old: snapshot ?? ""`) yields the same value. No observable change.

The private static grantKey(_:) is removed; resolveApproval (:245) and decide (:646) use the shared ApprovalRequest.Kind.grantKey extension (ProviderSession.swift:221-230) with the identical mapping command->"command", fileChange->"fileChange", tool/permissions/plan->"tool". No observable change.

BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: the private static todos(from:) is removed and todo_write now emits .todos(ACPSession.parseTodoItems(input["todos"])) (:348). Versus B2's Command Code parser, the shared parser (unchanged from B2 in ACPSession.swift:688-699) (a) adds a fourth text key "step", checked after "content" and "text" but BEFORE "title", so an entry with both step and title now shows the step; (b) skips an entry whose text is empty or whitespace/newline-only (B2 kept it as an empty todo); (c) maps "complete" to .done and "inProgress" / "in-progress" to .active (B2 only knew completed/done and in_progress/active). A missing todos array still yields an empty list that is still emitted.

Everything else (launch/argument vector, environment keys, gate, exit-code mapping, tool-row dispatch, literals) is byte-identical to B2; line numbers shift by -6 after B2 :58, 0 from B2 :82, -16 after B2 :340, -17 after B2 :442, -29 after B2 :545, -41 after B2 :648 and -49 after B2 :748 (B2 771 lines -> B3 722).
unresolved_questions: SessionSupport.swift (new at B3, holding EditSnapshots and StreamedTextTracker) has no unit in porting/deps/units.json; whether the port creates a shared C# SessionSupport unit that CommandCodeSession.cs must adopt (structural parity) or keeps its inline, behaviour-equivalent fields is an orchestrator/owner decision outside this bundle.
